commitResults.messageTitle: Modified programming and IDE experience to novice
Changed chtabot name from Duke to Buddy
Updated initial code to simply greet user and exit
Give Buddy ability to add and list tasks
Added the 'present-changes-visually' skill for claude code
implemented mark and unmark commands without additional classes
mark/unmark tasks, now with Task class
Buddy: extract task locals, tidy style, document main()
commitResults.messageBody:
listTasks, markTask, and unmarkTask repeatedly re-indexed
taskStorage for the same task; store it in a local `task`
variable instead so each method reads more clearly and avoids
redundant lookups. Also add the missing space before the brace
in the "mark" branch condition, per the SE-EDU Java coding
standard, and add a Javadoc comment to main() explaining Buddy's
run loop, since its behavior (read commands until "bye") is not
obvious from the signature alone.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-git-standard skill for commit/branch conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a skill capturing the SE-EDU Git conventions (commit subject
and body formatting, branch naming) so Claude applies them
automatically when drafting commits or branch names. Point
AGENTS.md at the skill under the Git section so the requirement
is discoverable from the project instructions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-java-coding-standard skill for Java style rules
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a skill capturing the SE-EDU intermediate Java coding
standard (naming, layout, statements, comments/Javadoc) so
Claude applies it when writing or editing .java files. Point
AGENTS.md at the skill under a new Java coding standard section
so the requirement is discoverable from the project instructions.
